= otCommissionerGeneratePskc(passPhrase, networkName, reinterpret_cast<const otExtendedPanId *>(extPanIdData), &pskc);","note":"The three attacker-controlled fields are forwarded into the commissioner implementation."},{"step":7,"file":"src/core/api/commissioner_api.cpp","function":"otCommissionerGeneratePskc","line":184,"var":"aPassPhrase/aNetworkName/aExtPanId","code":"return MeshCoP::Commissioner::GeneratePskc(...);","note":"The API wrapper passes the raw pointers directly to the core PSKC generator."},{"step":8,"file":"src/core/meshcop/commissioner.cpp","function":"Commissioner::GeneratePskc","line":1100,"var":"salt","code":"memcpy(salt, saltPrefix, strlen(saltPrefix)); memcpy(salt + saltLen, aExtPanId.m8, sizeof(aExtPanId)); memcpy(salt + saltLen, aNetworkName, strlen(aNetworkName));","note":"The vulnerable root cause is a stack-buffer-overflow write: the fixed-size local salt buffer is extended with attacker-controlled networkName bytes without checking that saltLen stays within OT_PBKDF2_SALT_MAX_LEN, so a long network name overflows the stack buffer before PBKDF2
